query: Aamir Khan has to look after his dead sister's three naughty kids while saving the family's debt-ridden factory. A runaway girl played by Juhi Chawla hides in their house and the kids help her. 'ghunghat ki aad se' song. Early 90s.

Govinda is a railway porter who pretends to be a millionaire to marry the daughter of a greedy rich man, a revenge plan by a matchmaker the father insulted. Karisma Kapoor. David Dhawan comedy, not the 2020 Varun Dhawan remake.

Salman Khan in a double role as twins separated as babies, one a street-smart tapori in Bombay and the other a shy musician from America, and whatever one does the other copies without control. 'tan tana tan tan tan tara' song. Not the 2017 Varun Dhawan one.

Bobby Deol hunts down the men who framed his soldier father as a traitor in an arms deal, and romances the daughter of one of them in Australia. Preity Zinta's debut I think. Late 90s, Abbas-Mustan, hit title song.

A police officer in Kashmir accidentally kills a boy's family during an anti-terror raid and adopts the orphan, who grows up to join militants and take revenge. Hrithik Roshan and Sanjay Dutt. 'bumbro' song. 2000.

An old retired couple's four sons refuse to keep both parents together, so they are split between two sons' houses. The father writes a bestselling book about it and the adopted son, played by Salman, helps them. Amitabh and Hema Malini, 2003.
A truck company owner falls for a fashion designer, they marry and fight constantly over money and his business losses, she leaves for Greece and he follows her. Shah Rukh and Rani Mukerji, 2003.

An aimless rich boy in Delhi with no goal in life joins the Indian army, quits, comes back, and leads a near impossible climb to capture a peak in the Kargil war. Hrithik Roshan, Preity Zinta plays a TV reporter. Farhan Akhtar directed.

A flirty cartoonist and a serious girl keep meeting by chance over many years, first on a flight to New York, then in Paris, and his comic strip about men and women becomes famous. Saif Ali Khan and Rani Mukerji. Maybe 2006?

Period romance in 1960s Calcutta based on a Sarat Chandra novel: a rich businessman's son and the orphan girl next door grow up together and secretly exchange garlands, but his father wants her uncle's house. Vidya Balan's debut, 'piyu bole'.

Three married men get into a mess of lies when one of them uses a bar singer to fool his friend's suspicious wife, and soon all three wives suspect. Salman, Anil Kapoor and Fardeen. Bipasha plays Bobby. Anees Bazmee comedy.

Ram Gopal Varma's take on The Godfather in Mumbai: a powerful father figure who runs a parallel justice system is framed for murder and his younger son takes charge. Amitabh and Abhishek Bachchan as father and son.

Shah Rukh Khan remake of the old Amitabh gangster film, set in Malaysia: a lookalike replaces a drug lord after he is shot, but the twist at the end is that the real Don was alive. Priyanka Chopra as Roma. 2006, not the 70s original.

Sequel where the three broke friends from the garage are now rich but lose everything in a money doubling scam and end up owing a gangster. Baburao with his thick glasses is back. Akshay, Suniel Shetty, Paresh Rawal.

A blind Kashmiri girl falls for a charming tour guide on a trip to Delhi, gets her eyesight back after surgery but he seems to die in a bomb blast; years later he turns up wounded at her snowy home and he's a terrorist. Aamir and Kajol.

Mani Ratnam's rags-to-riches story of a village man from Gujarat who builds a huge textile empire, loosely based on Dhirubhai Ambani, and fights a newspaper exposing him. Abhishek and Aishwarya, AR Rahman's 'tere bina'.

Comedy where a decent guy falls for the sister of two lovable gangsters, Uday bhai and Majnu bhai, who desperately want a respectable family. Majnu's terrible horse painting, Paresh Rawal as Dr Ghungroo. Akshay and Katrina.

A shy, simple electricity office clerk in Amritsar marries a lively young girl and, to win her heart, disguises himself as a flashy guy named Raj and joins her dance class. Anushka Sharma's debut, Shah Rukh, 2008.

Two college best friends in Mumbai who everyone thinks should date both find other partners; the story is told by friends waiting at an airport. The hero's dead father talks to his mother from a painting. Imran Khan's debut, AR Rahman, 2008.
Salman Khan is a ruthless hitman for a Mumbai don who falls for a gym instructor, and it turns out he is an undercover police officer. Hindi remake of Pokiri, 2009, Prabhu Deva directed.

film: Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai
query: Period gangster film about a gentleman smuggler in 70s Bombay who is like a Robin Hood, and a young cop's son who becomes his protégé and later turns on him. Inspired by Haji Mastan and Dawood. Ajay Devgn and Emraan Hashmi.

An honest police inspector from a small village in Maharashtra clashes with a gangster-politician who gets him transferred to Goa to break him. 'aata majhi satakli'. Ajay Devgn and Rohit Shetty, the first one, not Singham Again.

A shy NRI doctor comes to Kanpur to see a girl for an arranged marriage and falls for her, but she is a rebellious, drinking girl in love with a local goon. Madhavan and Kangana Ranaut. The first part, not Returns.

The remake where a boy whose teacher father was hanged by a bald villain grows up in Mumbai under a drug lord and returns to Mandwa for revenge. Sanjay Dutt is the scary bald Kancha, Rishi Kapoor plays Rauf Lala. 'chikni chameli'. Hrithik, not the 1990 one.
An alcoholic singer whose career is fading discovers a bar singer in Goa and makes her a star, but his drinking destroys him and he kills himself. 'tum hi ho'. Aditya Roy Kapur and Shraddha Kapoor.

Sanjay Leela Bhansali's colourful Romeo and Juliet set among two gun-running clans in a Gujarat village; the lovers elope and end up leading the rival families. Ranveer and Deepika's first film together. 'nagada sang dhol'.

A Tamil Brahmin boy in Varanasi is obsessively in love with a Muslim girl since childhood; she loves someone else, he causes her lover's death, then follows her into student politics in Delhi. Dhanush and Sonam Kapoor.

A struggling lawyer from Meerut takes on a rich boy's hit-and-run case where a car ran over people sleeping on the pavement, against a famous slick lawyer. The judge is hilarious. Arshad Warsi, the first one, not the Akshay sequel.
When Iraq invades Kuwait in 1990, a rich Indian businessman organises the evacuation of 170,000 Indians stranded there. Based on a true story. Akshay Kumar and Nimrat Kaur, 2016.
A road contractor goes to the forests of Arunachal Pradesh to build a highway, gets bitten by a wolf and turns into a werewolf at night. Varun Dhawan, horror comedy from the Stree universe, 2022.
Rajamouli film about two rival college student groups who unite and play a rugby match against a gangster's team to save their college land. Nithiin, 2004, Telugu.
Ravi Teja plays a petty con man in Hyderabad and his lookalike, an honest police officer fighting a village tyrant; the con man takes the cop's place. Rajamouli, remade in Hindi as Rowdy Rathore.
A Hindu guy who wants to be a film director falls for an older Malayali Christian girl living upstairs and her family objects. Gautham Menon, AR Rahman, Naga Chaitanya and Samantha's debut, 2010.
Two brothers who fight like cats and dogs; the carefree younger one helps his strict police officer elder brother defeat a gangster politician. Brahmanandam as 'Kill Bill Pandey'. Allu Arjun, 2014.
An environmental science student from Mumbai joins his uncle's garage in Hyderabad that fixes not just vehicles but people's problems. Jr NTR and Mohanlal, 2016.

A college lecturer kisses a sleeping girl on a night bus, she thinks he's a creep, and then it turns out she is his brother-in-law's sister. 'inkem inkem kaavaale' song. Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika, 2018.
A young man studying in London becomes Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh after his father dies, and starts fining traffic violators and fixing education. Mahesh Babu, 2018.
An army major goes to Kurnool to deliver news to a fellow soldier's family and fights a corrupt minister threatening them. Mahesh Babu, Vijayashanti's comeback, funny scenes on a train, 2020.
Balakrishna plays twins, one a farmer and the other an Aghora sadhu raised in Kashi, who fights a mining mafia destroying temples. Thaman's very loud background score, 2021.
A doctor goes on a treasure hunt across India for Lord Krishna's anklet hidden since the Mahabharata, chased by a secret group. Nikhil Siddhartha, a sequel that became a pan-India hit in 2022.
Mel Gibson as a Scottish rebel who leads an uprising against the English king after his wife is killed, with blue face paint, and shouts 'freedom' while being executed. Won best picture.
A death row prison guard in the 1930s meets a gentle giant convicted of killing two girls who can heal people with his touch, and a mouse that does tricks. Tom Hanks, a Stephen King story.

film: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
query: An orphan boy living under the stairs finds out on his 11th birthday that he's a wizard, goes to a magic school, plays a flying broom game and stops a teacher from stealing a magic stone. The first one, 2001.
Animated film where a grumpy green ogre and a talking donkey rescue a princess from a dragon for a short lord, and she turns into an ogre at night. Eddie Murphy voices the donkey. The first one.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
query: A drunken eccentric pirate captain helps a blacksmith rescue the governor's daughter from cursed pirates who turn into skeletons in the moonlight. Johnny Depp, the first one.

Boston crime thriller where an undercover cop infiltrates an Irish mob while the mob's mole works inside the police, and each tries to find the other. DiCaprio, Matt Damon, Jack Nicholson. Scorsese, remake of a Hong Kong film.

A boy from the Mumbai slums is one question away from winning the Indian Who Wants to Be a Millionaire and is arrested for cheating; flashbacks show how his life taught him each answer. 'jai ho' won the Oscar. Danny Boyle.
An Indian boy from Pondicherry survives a shipwreck and drifts across the Pacific in a lifeboat with a Bengal tiger named Richard Parker. Ang Lee, 3D.
Iron Man, Captain America, Thor and the Hulk team up for the first time to stop Thor's brother Loki and an alien army invading New York. 2012, the first team-up, not Endgame.

Decades later, a veteran navy fighter pilot returns to train a group of young pilots for a near-impossible bombing mission, including his late best friend's son. Tom Cruise, 2022, sequel to the 80s film.
